title: Make decision buttons say exactly what they do
tier_reason: Reversible local work authorized by Daniel; verify the result before completion.
ask:
Implement section 5 of docs/hq/HUMAN_INTERFACE_PLAN.md. Daniel authorized this redesign on 2026-09-21. Preserve the acceptance requirements in that section and coordinate with the other sections. Do not duplicate existing deliverable gate w44ff2049d9a.

Daniel proposes the heading Review: The revised seeder-bot animation and response labels Approve, Comment, Reject and Close. See the dated wording note in HUMAN_INTERFACE_PLAN.md; distinguish feedback from verdict and artifact rejection from closing a panel.

Daniel's live Queue correction on 2026-09-21 is part of this card: quiz/design-choice cards show every option as a selectable choice, followed by an always-present None of these — revise and ask me again choice, then the optional feedback field and one submit button. None-of-these requires feedback and returns the question to its owner for revision without recording a ruling; the revised card must pass readiness and be presented again. Fix blank owner wording such as Ask the with a resolved human name or the studio fallback. Apply and verify the shared behavior in Queue and direct-card views.
first_action: Read docs/hq/HUMAN_INTERFACE_PLAN.md section 5, inspect the current behavior and linked work, then implement and verify the specified outcome.
source_message: Daniel authorized the HQ redesign cards and a temporary Claude/Codex execution rule, followed by one supervised run.
result: Section 5 implementation: Queue and direct work cards now name acceptance, approval, comment without a verdict, and rejection that closes the review without deleting the artifact. Recommended answers, including No, appear in the acceptance action. Both surfaces preserve explanatory comments and show the recorded outcome and next work. Queue decision choices remain complete, with the feedback-required revision option; the selected option names the submit action. Unknown owners fall back to the studio. Focused JavaScript Queue/work tests and Python work/decision API tests passed. Live HQ had zero ready questions during this run, so no live verdict was submitted. This is an implementation record, not Daniel acceptance or CI confirmation.

model_selection.policy: Cost-conscious redesign: Terra build, Sol review once, escalate only when needed.
